message: 先輩の自重

name: Lolotte
message: 「If there aren't any additions to the pamphlet draft, I'm going to go ahead and print it~~」

name: Misa
message: 「I already gave you the precautions, prohibited items, and safety guidelines, right?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, I have them right here.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did my fun little column make the cut?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Due to page constraints, it was unfortunately scrapped.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Gabyo~n.」

name: Synn
message: 「You probably wrote nothing but nonsense anyway.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh my, isn't it missing a greeting from the Student Council President?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well, about that. The President said he was embarrassed and didn't want to write one--」

name: Synn
message: 「Waaah, waaah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then in its place, a greeting from the Treasurer--」

name: Synn
message: 「Fine, I'll write it! I'll write it right now!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tch. And I was so close!」
What does she want to assert so badly?

name: Synn
message: 「You really didn't have to go out of your way to make a page like that...」

name: Ria
message: 「You're the representative of the Student Council, you know. You've got to puff out your chest and go 'Bam!'」

name: Synn
message: 「I guess so... Even Ria-senpai wrote one last year. Alright, I'm gonna give a big 'Bam!' greeting!」

name: Ria
message: 「That's the spirit♪ That's the spirit♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There wasn't even a greeting page in last year's pamphlet, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「Shhhh!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh? The guide map page is missing.」

name: Misa
message: 「Did you actually submit it?」

name: Synn
message: 「I did, I did.」

name: Misa
message: 「You're just making excuses. You probably forgot, didn't you.」

name: Synn
message: 「I submitted them, right, Ria-senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah~」

name: Misa
message: 「Bringing up Senpai to back you up is playing dirty!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm sure I received them, though, they aren't here~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Loro-chan, don't tell me you slipped up and lost them?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I haven't fallen so low as to be told that by the treasurer.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm~~. Where could they have gone.」

name: Ria
message: 「Hey, Lolotte-chan. Did you take the pamphlets anywhere?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Only to the Student Council room and the Chairwoman's office, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「The Chairwoman's office?」

name: Misa
message: 「To see Helena-san?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. I thought that if we got the Chairwoman on our side, we could steamroll the teachers even if they complained.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, rather than complaints, let's call it having her check if there are any issues, okay.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So that means you handed them over to Helena-san once before.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, just as you say.」

name: Ria
message: 「I've got a bad feeling about this.」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's go check with Helena-san.」

name: Helena
message: 「Come in, it's unlocked.」

name: Helena
message: 「'Phew... A drink while working hits different, too. Go on, have some'」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that alcohol!?」

name: Helena
message: 「It's coffee, coffee. So, what business does the Student Council President who's staring at me uncrossing my legs have with me?」

name: Synn
message: 「I wasn't staring.\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Don't fall for her teasing.\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, I believe Lolotte had you look over the pamphlet draft--」

name: Helena
message: 「I gave it right back. There was one odd page mixed in, so I pulled it out for you, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「I knew it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Could that be the one that looks like an ukiyo-e print?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, yes. That's one of Ria's doodles, isn't it? Going through all that trouble just because you wanted to show me, oh my.」

name: Ria
message: 「*Smack*」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh my, what a cold reaction.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Actually, you see, that drawing was supposed to be the map for the KiraFes venue.」

name: Helena
message: 「Ehhh?! Really? I had no idea.」

name: Synn
message: 「So, um... we'd like that drawing back.」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, that's a problem... I'm terribly sorry, but I don't have it on hand anymore.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaat!! Did you throw it away or something?!」

name: Helena
message: 「I would never do that. What a waste that would be for such a fine work of art, wouldn't it?」

name: Ria
message: 「D-Don't tell me...」

name: Helena
message: 「Bingo! I went ahead and entered it into a contest.\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Again?!」

name: Synn
message: 「'Again'? Has this happened before?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Big Sis is always submitting my stuff without asking...」

name: Synn
message: 「Huhhh~」

name: Ria
message: 「Make sure you withdraw it, okay? I didn't draw it for a contest!」

name: Helena
message: 「I see~ If it was meant to be a map, I really should have given it a proper thumbs-down. I'm sorry.」

name: Helena
message: 「To put it bluntly, as a map and as part of a pamphlet, that drawing has zero value.」
Helena-san is probably the only person who can speak her mind so bluntly.
Ria-senpai wilts like salted mizuna greens.

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san. You don't have to go that far...」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun...」

name: Helena
message: 「Too soft! You're as overly sweet as a fukume sweet, Synn-chan!」
Helena-san sips her coffee while eating a monaka wafer generously dusted with sugar.

name: Helena
message: 「Ria. Your art is truly wonderful. However, nobody is asking for that kind of talent on this guide map.」

name: Helena
message: 「Be aware of your position. You're a senpai. If you make something with full confidence, nobody is going to be able to reject it.」

name: Helena
message: 「I understand getting absorbed in it, though. Act properly like an advisor, and like a member of the Student Council.」

name: Helena
message: 「Don't forget. The Student Council isn't just you. You have plenty of other reliable comrades you can count on.」

name: Ria
message: 「I see... So that's how it is... Sorry, Synn-kun. It looks like I made you walk on eggshells around me...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah... no, I did think that version might be fine too, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「You don't need to hold back... Please tell me clearly.」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai...」

name: Helena
message: 「Aha~ I bet you kept quiet because you didn't want Ria to dislike you, didn't you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!?」

name: Helena
message: 「'Hmph. I just don't want to hurt Ria, that's all'」

name: Helena
message: 「Acting tough like that!? Gee~~z, how adorable~\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「D-Does that mean...」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, that's not it!! I was just captivated by Ria-senpai--I mean, by Ria-senpai's art--!」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, Sis! You're troubling Synn-kun, you know.\s01」

name: Helena
message: 「O~h my, how scary, how scary.\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「Being like that is why everyone immediately leans on Ria. The Student Council President who left it all to her is equally guilty.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh.」

name: Ria
message: 「And you too, big sis, for submitting it without asking.」

name: Helena
message: 「Guh... Just as expected of my little sister, you're pretty sharp.」

name: Helena
message: 「My bad for jumping to conclusions. I'm really sorry.」

name: Helena
message: 「However, even if I withdraw the submission, it'll take quite a while for the artwork to be returned.」

name: Synn
message: 「It can't be helped... Let's make it all over again.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's for the best.」

name: Helena
message: 「'Sweetness is meant to be washed away by bitterness. Isn't that right?'」

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder? Come on, Synn-kun. Let's hurry back.」

name: Synn
message: 「Right!」

name: Ria
message: 「Big sis. Thank you for helping me realize something important.」
At those words, Helena-san gave a light wave of her hand.

name: Synn
message: 「And so, I'd like to borrow everyone's strength!」

name: Ria
message: 「Sorry about this...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't sweat it, don't sweat it. If everyone pitches in, we'll be done in no time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Don't be a stranger, Senpai-san.」

name: Misa
message: 「For Senpai's sake, I shall gladly assist you through fire and water.」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone, thank you...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, what's our time limit?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「We'd like to have it printed by the end of today.」

name: Synn
message: 「Then let's get started right away. Notebook, notebook... where did it go?」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Don't worry about the layout locations, I remember them all. Could you give out the instructions?」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-yes. Okay, Nanaka, you take the entrance.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You got it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa, you take the courtyard, and Lolotte, please handle Prier.」

name: Misa
message: 「Understood.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Got it~」

name: Synn
message: 「I'll take the area in front of the school building.」

name: Ria
message: 「The entrance only has the reception desk, so that'll be easy.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Piece of cake.」

name: Synn
message: 「All the more reason to make it really elaborate.」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee. All right, let's start with the courtyard. HQ is in the center, surrounded by 1-A, 1-B, and 1-C.」

name: Misa
message: 「Y-Yes!」

name: Ria
message: 「Doing okay? Next is 2-C, 2-B, 2-A. Then the stage goes in between, and across from it are 3-A, 3-B, and 3-C.」

name: Ria
message: 「Watch out--the second-years are lined up in reverse order. Should I repeat that part?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I can handle this much, thank you!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jot down a rough sketch before you forget.」

name: Ria
message: 「In front of the school building, we have the okonomiyaki stall, Yuugiri-an, the used book fair, and in the cake buffet corner, Chocolat l'Or and--」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek--my hand can't keep up!」

name: Ria
message: 「Don't panic. I'll repeat it from partway through.」

name: Ria
message: 「For the cake buffet: Chocolat l'Or, Sans Souci, Cafe Rose Blanche.」

name: Ria
message: 「Winter der Linden, Burgstadt, Tricolore, Konigsberg.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How's that for a lineup?!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's way too many.」

name: Ria
message: 「Finish it off with Shinagawa Produce and Ponpoko, and that's everything.」

name: Synn
message: 「All right!」

name: Ria
message: 「Next is Lolotte. Prier has the Wagashi Club and Five-Star Chinese Restaurant, and the rest are last-minute entries, so...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's make it a fun corner.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. That sounds great♪」
Thanks to Ria-senpai reading it all off smoothly, the base layout came together just as effortlessly as last time.
I double-checked it against the notebook just in case, and there wasn't a single mistake.

name: Synn
message: 「Still, man, I'm amazed you remember all this so accurately~」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahem. I am your senpai, after all.」
It's probably less because she's a senpai and more because she's "Ria-senpai."

name: Synn
message: 「Alright, let's move on to the finishing touches!」
While staring hard at the academy's floor plan, we add scenery and illustrations to give it a lively feel.

name: Nanaka
message: 「How about something like this?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's Mr. Panda!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Nanaka. Draw it a little cuter, okay? Like this--」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll sneak a little doodle in too.」

name: Synn
message: 「And line up some international flags--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Stop, that's so tacky!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Let's put antennae on Mr. Panda.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't turn him into a bug!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa! There's some kind of creature right here!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha... That's actually Paa-chan, though.\s01」
And just like that, the blank white spaces rapidly get filled up.

name: Ria
message: 「Making things together with everyone really is more fun, isn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, totally.」

name: Ria
message: 「Seeing it come together really makes it sink in that the festival's almost here, doesn't it? It's getting me all excited.」
It ended up having a pretty casual, freewheeling vibe.

name: Lolotte
message: 「It looks like it'll make you happy just looking at it.」

name: Misa
message: 「All you guys did was doodle pranks all over Blackuma!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So colorful!!」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll end up in monochrome, though.」

name: Ria
message: 「I wonder if Big Sis will be satisfied with this.」

name: Helena
message: 「My, you've made something quite nice.」

name: Synn
message: 「Talk about good timing.」

name: Helena
message: 「Of course, because I was waiting until you finished. Just kidding, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「Not even an opening for a comeback.」

name: Helena
message: 「Yes, yes. This is just what I was hoping for. Now this really feels like this year's Student Council.」

name: Helena
message: 「Still--pfft... hehe. At this rate, it's practically 'Where's Paqy!!'」

name: Synn
message: 「Some of them are something else entirely, though.」

name: Helena
message: 「If you include the ones Ria drew, the difficulty level looks pretty high.」

name: Ria
message: 「I drew them to look really cool, though~~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, is it really alright for us to play around this much...」

name: Misa
message: 「Compared to last year's pamphlet, it does feel like we went a bit overboard.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's kind of all over the place, too.」

name: Helena
message: 「Why not? There's nothing wrong with having an unconventional Student Council like this.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right. That's why I wanted to keep doing the Student Council together with everyone, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「Cutting loose and making it together with everyone turns out better. That's what you wanted to say, right, Big Sis?」

name: Helena
message: 「Who knows? You all made it this way because you thought it was better yourselves, didn't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Geez, stop getting so shy♪」

name: Helena
message: 「I envy how you can see it that way, Ria. If you don't praise the Student Council President who took the lead more than me, he'll start sulking.」

name: Synn
message: 「I won't sulk!」

name: Helena
message: 「Oh, there's still a blank page left, isn't there?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Isn't that the part we asked the President to handle?」

name: Synn
message: 「Cutting loose and making it together with everyone... huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「And so, the Student Council President's greeting page has been changed to a greeting from the entire Student Council!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My time has finally come!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Good grief, there's no helping you.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. That was a nice way to dodge it, wasn't it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course, I'm going to have you write a part too, Ria-senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Go ahead and write to your heart's content to make up for not getting to last year!」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez!!」
Everyone finished writing it in no time.

name: Synn
message: 「All done!」

name: Ria
message: 「Congrats~!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good work~!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Come now, Lolotte-san. Let's hurry.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm off to get it printed~!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whew~」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, Synn-kun. Here's your stamp card back~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah. When did you--」

name: Ria
message: 「Heehee, it's a secret. You worked really hard!」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh. I'm only one stamp away now!」

name: Ria
message: 「I won't give you the final one so easily, you know.\s04」
So that's the punchline after all, huh.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, what's that!? Give me one too!!」

name: Ria
message: 「W-Well, that's...」

name: Helena
message: 「Well then, since such a splendid pamphlet has been completed, allow me to celebrate with you.」

name: Synn
message: 「What's the Nika Exhibition?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, Synn, you don't even know that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry about that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Though I don't know either.」

name: Helena
message: 「It's a small art exhibition.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, I just remembered. Big Sis... you did cancel it properly, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「By the way, you two, what did you think after seeing Ria's painting?」

name: Synn
message: 「You mean Ria-senpai's painting?」

name: Helena
message: 「Yeah, yeah.」
What do I even say...
Aah, Ria-senpai is staring at me. I'd better just be honest about this.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sorry. Um... I don't really get it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Really? I have no idea what genre it is, but it feels like a stylish painting.」

name: Synn
message: 「She definitely has a rich range of styles. You're really versatile, Ria-senpai.」

name: Helena
message: 「Right, right?! She's my pride and joy of a little sister~~!!」

name: Ria
message: 「S-stop it already...\s03」

name: Helena
message: 「That's why, you know, a sudden impulse gets the better of me and I end up submitting it.」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't ever draw them with that intention--」

name: Helena
message: 「Fine, fine. You just want me to cancel it, right, cancel it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, it might surprisingly get good reviews.」

name: Helena
message: 「Right! Right!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...\s02」
